artLabel: A bright cock discovers a luminous pearl among the farmyard straw.

pageArt.alt: The Cock roots beneath the straw and uncovers a shining Pearl.
The Cock leaves the Pearl in the straw and searches for a barley-corn.

scenes: A cock was once strutting up and down the farmyard among the hens when suddenly he espied something shinning amid the straw.
“Ho! ho!” quoth he, “that’s for me,” and soon rooted it out from beneath the straw. “What did it turn out to be but a Pearl that by some chance had been lost in the yard?
“You may be a treasure,” quoth Master Cock, “to men that prize you, but for me I would rather have a single barley-corn than a peck of pearls.”
Precious things are for those that can prize them.
